description: This file is a shell script testing suite for the 'git hash-object' command, including setup functions, test cases for various input conditions, error handling, and behavior verification related to hashing objects in git. It includes functions to initialize repositories, hash files and stdin, and verify the existence or absence of objects in the git database.

methods.name: echo_without_newline
methods.description: Prints arguments to stdout without a newline.

methods.name: test_blob_does_not_exist
methods.description: Verifies that a blob object with a given oid does not exist in the git database.

methods.name: test_blob_exists
methods.description: Verifies that a blob object with a given oid exists in the git database.

methods.name: setup_repo
methods.description: Initializes a git repository and creates sample files for testing.

methods.name: push_repo
methods.description: Creates a new repository and sets it up for testing.

methods.name: pop_repo
methods.description: Removes the test repository and returns to the previous directory.
